thread:
maia: FYI I hit a case in staging where the fallback kicked and the console only showed 'policy matched' with no clue what metric crossed. operator had to dig through logs.

ranjit: Do we currently store the evaluated metric values with the decision? I thought we had a small payload but maybe sampling dropped it

maia: We store a tiny decision_event with reason_code and policy_id. We do not persist the raw window stats unless audit sampling captures it.

hank: That is the root cause. Sampling + routing-level telemetry short-circuit means we might not have the numbers that explain the decision. UX asks: show operator the short explanation and a link to the trace (if available). If trace missing, show "insufficient telemetry" + suggested next steps.

maia: Suggestion: introduce a 'decision_summary' blob (deterministic, cheap) that always gets persisted for every fallback event. It would include: reason_code, evaluated_value(s) rounded, model_ids, mode (soft/hard), policy_version, attribution_metrics (tokens_served_est). No customer PII.

zoe: That sounds good. For operator console display we can show the decision_summary inline, and a CTA 'view full trace' if audit captured it. Also allow copying a compact permalink for support tickets.

ranjit: Implementation nuance: decision_summary should be <1KB per event to keep topic volume reasonable. Also add a flag 'force_capture_reason' for orgs in debug canaries which causes full decision_trace capture.

maia: Proto draft (compact):

```text
policy_id=autofallback-2026-03
reason=ER
evaluated_value=0.062
threshold=0.05
mode=soft
reroute=model-small-v3
policy_ver=12
tokens_est=1345
sampled_examples=3
```

maia: Thoughts on naming scheme: reason codes should be human-searchable and machine-parseable. e.g. ER = error rate, LAT = latency p95, THR = token hemorrhage, QPS = overloaded route.

zoe: +1. For customer-facing logs: send compact code + human-friendly fallback hint (no metrics). e.g. "fallback=ER" and the status header: "serving=small-model (catV)"

hank: Security note: do not include raw request inputs in decision_summary. If org opts in for debug exports, store examples in KMS-encrypted bucket and show only for approved internal roles.

ops-bot: rollout:autofallback 1765440044  feature flag 'decision_summary' enabled for staging clusters

ranjit: We should also record quota signals that caused telemetry short-circuit: store a telemetry_coverage_estimate in the summary (0.0-1.0). That helps show when "missing trace" is expected.

maia: Good call. I'll add telemetry_coverage_estimate and a small enum coverage_reason {sampling, quota_shortcircuit, none}.

product-bot: ux-ticket#1427 created  title="Fallback explainability: decision_summary + CTA" assigned to @zoe @maia

zoe: UX question: where to place the CTA? My proposal: under the route detail pane, show a one-line summary and a chevron to expand timeline (trigger -> decision_summary -> routing -> examples if available). Keep collapsed view minimal.

ranjit: Back-end: new topic 'fallback_summaries' (compact) + 'fallback_traces' (full). Replication: only keep summaries in hot tier for 30d, traces in cold long-term store (S3) with 90d retention unless org requests extension.

maia: retention + costs make sense. Also propose we add a per-org capture budget: e.g. max_full_traces_per_min and summary_rate_cap. Defaults: full_traces=0.01% for free orgs, 1% for paid, and unlimited for enterprise with approved contract.

hank: Can product-bot add a note to ticket about billing attribution: we must track tokens on fallback so billing lines remain accurate.

product-bot: noted. ux-ticket#1427 updated with billing note

maia: Action items I'll take: 1) PR for decision_summary schema (compact fields only) 2) feature flag + migration path to enable summaries globally, 3) add telemetry_coverage_estimate & coverage_reason enum. I'll post PR and link the UX mockups.

zoe: I'll attach a mockup showing collapsed + expanded views and sample copy for sanitized customer logs.

ranjit: I'll prototype the new Kafka topics & processor in the infra spike. Hank, can you review schema for security gating?

hank: Yep. Will review and raise any redaction requirements. Also add doc for how to request full-trace access for support incidents.

maia: Thanks all. If nobody objects I'll move forward and open the PR this afternoon.

zoe: No objections. thanks. :rocket:
